integrity: A standalone exact rational verifier and observed stdout accompany the analytic proofs. Finite enumeration is not treated as proof of the infinite stability criterion or almost-sure absorption. The distinct all-oracle frontier and binary example were compared against accessible primary sources and relevant published findings, but exhaustiveness of prior-art search is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for scalar fixed-step i.i.d. multiplicative independent oracle with finite second moment and zero backward operator; the universal state claim is for every deterministic initial pair. No generalization to nonlinear, multidimensional, additive noise or dependent sampling. First public motivating algorithm predates this result. No assertion of independent verification.
title: Sharp mean-square frontier and finite-hit divergence for stochastic reflected gradients
